description: IL-level model recommendations for AI paradigms used in AAC capability mapping.

il4.notes: Use Azure OpenAI Service with CUI banner and private endpoint. No fine-tuning required for standard generation tasks.

il5.notes: Azure OpenAI on IL5-accredited tenant with private networking and token auditing enabled.

il6.notes: Air-gapped deployment on SIPR-only infrastructure. NSA Type 1 encryption at rest and in transit.

il4.notes: Requires curated labeled dataset (≥1K samples). Use scikit-learn or XGBoost with standard cross-validation.

il5.notes: Train on IL5-classified compute (SageMaker GovCloud or Azure ML). Encrypt training artifacts with CMK.

il6.notes: Train on air-gapped compute. Data must be sanitized and labeled by cleared personnel. Export models via approved media only.

il4.notes: Use sentence-transformers with local vector DB (ChromaDB, Qdrant, or Milvus). No fine-tuning needed for generic semantic search.

il5.notes: Host embedding model on IL5 compute. Index vectors in dedicated VPC with no public egress.

il6.notes: Run sentence-transformers locally on SIPR. Corpus must be sanitized; no cloud vector store. Use FAISS or flat index on classified storage.

il4.notes: Requires historical time-series or tabular data. Unsupervised approach but needs baseline distribution.

il5.notes: Deep autoencoder on IL5 GPU compute. Historical data must be encrypted at rest and access-logged per NIST AU-6.

il6.notes: Hybrid statistical thresholds + small ML model on air-gapped compute. All data must be sanitized and cleared for training.

il4.notes: Requires simulation environment or sandbox. RL training is not zero-shot; policy must be validated before deployment.

il5.notes: Multi-agent orchestration on IL5 compute. Provide policy examples and guardrails; agents must be audited per NIST AC-2.

il6.notes: Combine deterministic rule engine with local LLM on SIPR. All agent actions logged; no external tool access.

il4.notes: LangChain ReAct agent with LLM as reasoning engine. No training data needed; configure tools and prompts.

il5.notes: LangGraph state-machine agent on IL5 compute. Define workflow nodes and edges; all state transitions logged.

il6.notes: Replace cron with local LLM-driven agentic scheduler on SIPR. Uses Ollama + custom trigger logic; no cloud dependency.

il4.notes: Use pre-trained BERT-NER or spaCy NER. Zero-shot for standard entities; few-shot fine-tuning improves domain accuracy.

il5.notes: Fine-tuned RoBERTa on IL5 compute. Requires annotated corpus for domain-specific entity extraction.

il6.notes: Local spaCy transformer pipeline on SIPR. Annotated data must be sanitized; model trained offline and transferred via approved media.
